problems: Both dossiers validate with no errors or warnings, also with --resolve.

Fourteen distinct pages were opened (Salian Franks, Clovis I, Battle of Soissons (486), Childeric I, Chlodio, Ripuarian Franks, Franks, History of Cologne, Battle of Tolbiac, Gallic Empire, Trier, Sigebert the Lame, Crossing of the Rhine, Germania Inferior); the Salian dossier cites the Tolbiac and Ripuarian Franks pages as well as its five, so its sources list has 7 against a budget of 5 (sources_total counts that reuse).

Cliopatria's three Frankish rows are disjoint in 462-509 (Salian, Ripuarian and Kingdom of the Franks, 28,600 km2 holding Cologne): the eu-07 owner of kingdom-of-the-franks must decide what that row is. Cliopatria's Salian 490 shape is the 452 shape plus the Kingdom of Soissons shape and its 500 shape adds the Kingdom of Alamannia shape (which reaches Lorraine and holds Trier).

Counterpart slugs differ across dossiers: kingdom-of-soissons (486) and visigothic-kingdom (507) name kingdom-of-the-franks as receiver where salian-franks names itself; western-roman-empire names kingdom-of-the-franks for 462 where ripuarian-franks names the Western Roman Empire as the source of Cologne. Phase C should reconcile (Clovis's realm is the Salian row to 509 and the Franks row from 510).

The Ripuarian Franks row before the Cologne kingdom (238-461) is a Cliopatria grouping: the Ripuarian Franks page says the name did not originate as a tribal name. Phase C may prefer to start the state in 462 and label the earlier ribbon as Franks of the Lower Rhine.
